monthly.name: Kareer Monthly
monthly.terms: Renews every month until you cancel. Adds 1,000 credits each paid month; unused monthly credits expire when that month ends. If you cancel, the plan stops at the end of the month you already paid for.

pack.name: Kareer Credit Pack
pack.summary: 300 credits that never expire. No subscription.
pack.terms: 300 credits that do not expire. No subscription needed; pack credits stay after a plan ends.
